Class TrafficManager

java.lang.Object
TrafficManager
public class TrafficManager extends Object
Manages all traffic simulation objects including junctions, edges, vehicles, and traffic lights.

This class serves as the central manager for the visual traffic network, handling:

  • Creating visual objects from parsed network data
  • Updating vehicle positions from SUMO simulation data
  • Updating traffic light states from SUMO
  • Rendering all simulation objects in proper layered order
  • Hit detection for user interaction (clicking on objects)
  • Highlighting selected and hovered objects

The manager maintains several collections:

  • Visual junctions and edges created from network topology
  • Dynamic vehicles updated each simulation step
  • Traffic lights with multiple signals per junction
  • Index maps for fast lookup by ID

    • initializeFromNetwork

      public void initializeFromNetwork(NetworkParser.NetworkData network)
      Initializes all visual objects from parsed network data. Creates junctions, edges, lanes, and traffic lights from SUMO network topology.

    • updateVehicles

      public void updateVehicles(Map<String,double[]> vehiclePositions)
      Updates vehicle positions and states from SUMO simulation data. Creates new vehicles as they appear and removes vehicles that have left the simulation.
      Parameters:
      vehiclePositions - Map from vehicle ID to array [x, y, angle, signals]

    • updateTrafficLights

      public void updateTrafficLights(Map<String,TrafficLight.TrafficLightData> tlData)

      Parameters:
      tlData - Map from junction ID to traffic light state data

    • setJunctionManualMode

      public void setJunctionManualMode(String junctionId, boolean manualMode, String state)
      Sets manual mode for ALL traffic lights at a junction. This ensures the entire junction is synchronized in manual or automatic control.
      Parameters:
      junctionId - The junction ID
      manualMode - true for manual control, false for automatic
      state - Optional state string to set (can be null)

    • getElementAt

      public Object getElementAt(double screenX, double screenY, CoordinateTransform transform)
      Performs hit detection to find the simulation object at the given screen coordinates. Checks layers in order: vehicles (top), traffic lights, junctions, lanes (bottom).
      Parameters:
      screenX - The X coordinate in screen space
      screenY - The Y coordinate in screen space
      transform - The coordinate transformation
      Returns:
      The object at that position, or null if none

    • renderHighlight

      public void renderHighlight(javafx.scene.canvas.GraphicsContext g, CoordinateTransform transform, Object selected, Object hovered)
      Renders highlight overlays for selected and hovered objects. Selected objects are highlighted in cyan, hovered in yellow.
